Ruth (Acct Mgmt): I have two renewals closing next week. Want a one-liner we can add to renewal threads offering replay support and a small credit.
Maya (CS): Draft below  very short.
Maya (CS): ```
Hi {CustomerName},
We experienced a brief issue on {date} (approx 08:589:18 UTC) that caused some onboarding requests for EU tenants to fail. If you tried to onboard or install integrations during that time and are missing events, reply and well replay them for you. We can also provide a goodwill credit for material impact.
Quick steps for self-service replay:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/replay -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"tenant":"<id>"}'
Thanks,
Maya & Redwood CS
```
